description: This PHP class defines a GitLab resource owner for OAuth2 authentication, providing methods to access user details and to instantiate an API client.

classes.name: GitlabResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a GitLab user resource obtained via OAuth2, providing user info and a method to access the GitLab API client.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with user data and access token.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured GitLab API client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the owner.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the owner.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the owner.

methods.name: getAvatarUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to the owner's avatar.

methods.name: getProfileUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to the owner's profile.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines if the user is active.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Determines if the user has admin privileges.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Determines if the user is external.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all user data as an array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a value from the data array.
